symptom: After physical RESET, no microphone enumeration or visible application response; only ST-LINK present.
diagnosis: Reset vector catch left enabled by the previous debugging configuration; no application fault reported by CFSR/HFSR in this observation.

recovery.change: Cleared only VC_CORERESET; other observed DEMCR bits retained. Application execution and USB enumeration resumed.

physical_reset_validation.operator: User pressed physical RESET and reported waiting approximately 5 seconds
physical_reset_validation.present_device_status: USB composite and audio interface OK

analysis.limits: Room audio is uncontrolled. These metrics do not establish frequency response, calibrated gain, or absence of every USB packet loss.

limitations: One user-operated physical RESET verified; repeated resets and a power-cycle test were not performed.
No live MCU counters read during the post-reset 15-second recording.
Earlier 120 s/60 s denoiser tests validated continuing execution, not physical RESET startup.
